questions.text: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: let creates a variable scoped to the nearest block.

questions.text: Which method turns a JSON string into a JavaScript object?
questions.explanation: JSON.parse reads valid JSON text and returns the matching value.

questions.text: Which hook stores state inside a function component?

questions.text: Why should state updates based on previous state use a callback?
options: It receives the latest state safely

questions.text: What should you avoid doing directly to React state?
questions.explanation: React needs new references to detect and render changes reliably.

questions.text: What usually belongs in derived state?
